findings.description: AWS access-key credentials are embedded in the Lambda environment variables and Terraform source. Lambda environment configuration is readable by principals with Lambda configuration read access, and the committed credentials must be treated as exposed.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security patches and can leave the workload exposed to known runtime vulnerabilities.
